title: Some More of Our Treasure Items (continued)

items.name: Two ornate Bali priest rings
items.description: Balinese style of crafting prongs shaped like birds' beaks to secure center stone
items.details: Ring on right features large pink ruby (Tuyet Nguyet collection)

items.name: Gold box from Tuyet Nguyet collection
items.description: Intricate carving - deer on front, chicken on back
items.rarity: Author has not come across any similar box that exists anywhere

items.name: Titanium physical Bitcoin coin by BTCC
items.description: Coins like this no longer produced, only a few ever rated by PCGS
items.details: Comes with fully loaded private keys to one digital Bitcoin (keys beneath hologram on back)
items.quantity: One of only 1350 titanium coins made by BTCC in first production in 2016
items.note: Company made just 250 more coins after 2016

items.name: Olive-green jade bracelet
items.description: One of oldest jade bracelets known to exist
items.significance: Jade highly valued in China for thousands of years, symbolized purity and moral integrity
items.etymology: 'Jingqi' meaning life force, believed to carry energy of life itself
items.virtues: Charity, rectitude, wisdom, courage, and equity
